name: serpapi_google_events
description: Find upcoming events through Google's current mobile Events search. Use for concerts, festivals, comedy, markets, family activities, conferences, nightlife, things happening today or this week, or general 'events near me' requests. Returns dates, venues, prices, public/ticket/map links, images and event identifiers when available. Date and virtual requests become search-query preferences, not guaranteed filters; verify the returned dates and participation mode. Retrieval is fixed to US English but supports international destinations in query/location. Pagination is not supported. Keep event keywords in query and put the city in location. When location is omitted, use the configured default location or postal code; never infer geography from a proxy. Qualify ambiguous cities, such as Portland, Oregon or Portland, Maine. Use serpapi_google_local for businesses and serpapi_tripadvisor for attractions.

query.description: Required event keywords such as events, live music, family-friendly events, food festivals, or comedy. Usually omit the city and use location. A full Google-style query such as 'concerts in Portland, Maine' is also accepted and will not be duplicated.

location.description: Optional city-level location. Include state, region, or country when ambiguous, for example Portland, Oregon or Portland, Maine. When omitted, uses the configured default location or postal code. Cannot be combined with uule.

uule.description: Advanced Google-encoded search origin. Cannot be combined with location. Because uule is not human-readable, put any desired event city directly in query. Retrieval remains US English.

date_filter.description: Optional date preference added to the search query as today, tomorrow, this week, next week, this month or next month. This is not a strict date filter; verify each returned event's dates. Omit for the normal upcoming-event range.

virtual.description: Prefer virtual events by adding virtual to the search query. Google may still return in-person events; this does not enforce virtual-only results. Can be combined with date_filter. Default false.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized events to return. Default 10.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved current Google Events parameters passed through to SerpApi. Query, location, cache and output controls cannot be overridden. Removed htichips/event_type filters, locale overrides and pagination are rejected.

include_raw.description: Include the full SerpApi JSON response for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file. For location-free prompts, also set JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE.
